biography.value:
"NINE" (Vesk Half-made, the Unshaped) — level 3 PC pregen, Flesh-Crafted scaleweave-warped, fighting its own body. Kin to Gruffud the Writhing.

Manual: resistance is acid — DM may re-pick per mutation. Writhing Lash escape DC 13 (remove the Grappled condition when the target escapes). Natural armor — AC includes warped hide.

abilities.name: Manacle-Flail
abilities.desc: An iron cuff still chained to the tendril, swung hard. Melee weapon attack: 1d6+3 bludgeoning on a hit.
